verdict.rationale: Stripe documents payouts from your available balance to a linked bank account, Dashboard tracking of payouts and expected deposit dates, and downloadable payout and balance report runs, with payouts and balance transactions also readable through its MCP tools. Together these give some first-party basis for reconciling what goes into a payout. Nothing in the evidence shows the user can control the payout schedule (daily, weekly, monthly or manual), and itemized per-payout breakdowns are only implied. missing for 10: documented payout schedule control, explicit per-payout itemization of charges/fees/refunds, independent or hands-on corroboration of reconciliation.
